headline: Protests at DMCH: Doctors and students confine director over staff transfers
summary: Protesters at Dhaka Medical College Hospital have taken the director's office into custody to express their dissatisfaction with staff transfers.
details: Doctors and students at Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) have launched a protest against the transfer of staff members.
The situation escalated as protesters confined the director of the hospital within his office to demand a review of the transfer orders.
The protest is centered on the staff transfer decisions, which the medical professionals and students have deemed unfair or unnecessary.
Hospital administration is currently dealing with the situation as the protesters continue to demand a resolution to the cause of their unrest.

headline_marked: Govt to provide [[full security for Sheikh Hasina]] if she returns
headline: Govt to provide full security for Sheikh Hasina if she returns
summary: Prime Minister's Information Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman says the ousted leader will be brought to trial with all legal and constitutional rights guaranteed.
details: Prime Minister's Information Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman announced that the government will ensure full security for ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina if she returns to Bangladesh.
Zahed stated that Hasina, who has mentioned returning in December, would be brought to trial with all her legal and constitutional rights guaranteed.
The adviser emphasized that everyone must accept the verdict delivered by the court, regardless of the political affiliation of the accused.
Regarding former lawmaker and cricketer Shakib Al Hasan, Zahed said he could also return under full security to face the allegations against him.
However, the adviser criticized Shakib, calling him a 'spoiled and rotten person' for his alignment with the previous regime.
Zahed reiterated that the government will not allow any 'fascist or mafia regime' to return to the country, asserting that Bangladesh is now a democratic state.
He also dismissed speculations about the recent visit of India's intelligence chief Parag Jain to Dhaka, calling it part of routine engagement between the two nations.
caption:
Sheikh Hasina will get full security if she returns to Bangladesh, but she will be brought to trial.

Prime Minister's Information Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman announced that the government will ensure full security for ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina if she returns to Bangladesh.

Zahed stated that Hasina, who has mentioned returning in December, would be brought to trial with all her legal and constitutional rights guaranteed.

The adviser emphasized that everyone must accept the verdict delivered by the court, regardless of the political affiliation of the accused.

Regarding former lawmaker and cricketer Shakib Al Hasan, Zahed said he could also return under full security to face the allegations against him.

However, the adviser criticized Shakib, calling him a 'spoiled and rotten person' for his alignment with the previous regime.

Zahed reiterated that the government will not allow any 'fascist or mafia regime' to return to the country, asserting that Bangladesh is now a democratic state.

He also dismissed speculations about the recent visit of India's intelligence chief Parag Jain to Dhaka, calling it part of routine engagement between the two nations.

#Bangladesh #SheikhHasina #Politics #Dhaka #Justice

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
